verses.text: Then Jacob called for his sons and said, "Gather around, so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come.
Gather together and listen, sons of Jacob. Listen to your father Israel.
Reuben, you are my firstborn, my strength, the first sign of my power. You were first in honour and first in power.
But you are as wild as rushing water, and you will no longer be first, because you went up onto your father's bed. You disgraced my bed when you lay on it.
Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
Let me not join in their secret plans. Let me not be part of their group, because in their anger they killed men, and they crippled oxen just as they pleased.
May their anger be cursed, because it is so fierce, and their fury, because it is so cruel! I will scatter them among the people of Jacob and spread them out among the people of Israel.
Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies, and your father's sons will bow down to you.
You are a lion's cub, Judah. You come back from the hunt, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down. Like a lioness, who dares to wake him?
The royal sceptre will not leave Judah, nor the ruler's staff his descendants, until the one comes to whom it belongs. The nations will obey him.
He will tie his donkey to a vine, his young donkey to the best branch. He will wash his clothes in wine, his robes in the juice of grapes.
His eyes will be darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a harbour for ships. His border will reach as far as Sidon.
Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between two loads.
When he sees how good his resting place is and how pleasant his land is, he will bend his shoulder to carry the load and will be forced to work as a slave.
Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
Dan will be a snake by the road, a poisonous snake along the path, that bites the horse's heels so that its rider falls backwards.
I look to you to save me, LORD.
Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them as they run away.
Asher's food will be rich. He will provide food fit for a king.
Naphtali is a deer running free that has beautiful young.
Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.
Archers attacked him fiercely. They shot at him and hated him.
But his bow stayed steady, and his strong arms stayed firm, because of the power of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,

because of your father's God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you. He blesses you with blessings from the sky above, blessings from the deep waters below, and blessings of many children and many animals.

Your father's blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, greater than the riches of the age-old hills. May all these blessings rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the one who was set apart from his brothers.
Benjamin is a hungry wolf. In the morning he eats what he has caught, and in the evening he divides what he has taken."
These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them. He gave each one the blessing that was right for him.
Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to join my people who have died. Bury me with my ancestors in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan. Abraham bought it, together with the field, from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
That is where Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried. Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried there, and there I buried Leah.
The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites."
When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last, and joined his people who had died.
